[Pending Restart] - [Shattered Halls] - Kargath Bladefists Blade Dance ability now only lasts for 10 seconds, down from from 15 seconds and now only happens once every 40 seconds up from every 30 seconds.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Added a description to the Badge of Justice indicating its purpose and where to spend these Badges.

[Pending Restart] - Items bought from Geras or Edrim Skysong (Mythic 0 Coin Vendor) will now also abide by the refund rule that tier token vendors and Romus the Redeemer have. You may now sell back any item purchased from Geras or Edrim Skysong up to 2 hours after the purchase, enchanting this item or applying a mystic enchantment onto these items will void the refundability.

[Pending Restart] - Ever accidentally recycled an item when trying to upgrade an item at Edrim Skysong (Mythic Coin Vendor)? Fear not, Ameer Greatluck will now be able to recover accidentally recycled M+ items for 50 Mythic Coins.

[Pending Restart] - Removed the following daily quests from pooling on the callboard such as but not limited to: The Arms Race: "Ragesteel Shoulders, Learning The Ropes: Crown of the Sea Witch" whose price to craft was not reasonable for a daily craft. Most quests removed required VERY timegated materials that could take potential weeks to craft or the crafting price was upwards of 1,500 gold or more to craft. Similar quests that are not as expensive nor as timegated will soon be moved to a weekly quest pool and have a much greater reward.
[Pending Restart] - Geras will now offer Runed Fungalcap and Wrathtide Longbow.
[Pending Restart] - Prestigious Caches will now always reward gear from Tier 4.

[Pending Restart] - Callboard Caches have been reworked and make their return to level 70! This callboard cache intends to serve as a catchup mechanic and as an alternative way to progress your character and earn gear while simultaneously providing more value to daily and weekly quests. The following quest types will reward Callboard Caches: Profession Quests, Hero's Call (Rewards x2 caches), Keeping Evil at Bay, Population Control, World Boss (Rewards x2 caches). These callboard caches can not drop current tier raid gear and can only drop normal mode gear from the previous tier.

[Pending Restart] - Path to Ascension: Geras is a new Path to Ascension quest to introduce players into Geras. This quest rewards 750 Marks of Ascension, 5 Mystic Runes and 5 Orbs and 10 Badges of Justice.

[Pending Restart] - [Sethekk Halls] - Creatures that summons a mind control totem now has a 1.5 second cast time on the summon of said totem and can be interrupted or stunned to prevent the placement of the totem.

[Pending Restart] - [Sethekk Halls] - The Duration of "Arcane Shield" (Damage Immunity Shield) has been lowered to 5 seconds from 8 seconds. This means you can get back in combat with Talon King Ikiss immediately after his long Arcane Explosion cast instead of having 3 seconds of him being able to attack you and you not being able to attack back.
[Pending Restart] - [Shattered Halls] - The Duration of Corpse Runner has been increased by 10 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - [Shattered Halls] - Kidney Shot from Assassins will now correctly obey Diminishing Returns.
[Pending Restart] - [Blood Furnace] - Kidney Shot from Assassins will now correctly obey Diminishing Returns.

[Pending Restart] - [Shadow Labyrinth] - The Instant Cast Shocks from the cultists will no longer target totems. This means that your tremor totem and other supporting totems will not be instantly sniped upon putting them down.
[Pending Restart] - [Shadow Labyrinth] - Ambassador Hellmaw's fear will now have a 1.25 second cast time and can be interrupted and will now correctly obey Diminishing Returns.
[Pending Restart] - [Shadow Labyrinth] - Kidney Shot from Cabal Assassins will now correctly obey Diminishing Returns.

[Pending Restart] - [Mana Tombs] - Mana Leech''s mana burn in Mana Tombs now burn 4% of your mana up to a maximum of 350 mana, down from 8% of your total mana and their attack speed has been reduced to 1.8 seconds from 1.4 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - [Hellfire Ramparts] - Reduced the amplitude of which Watchkeeper Gargolmar would cast his Whirling Slash (knockback) by 40%.
[Pending Restart] - [Hellfire Ramparts] - Mana Burns from Mana Hounds on Omor the Unscarred in Hellfire Ramparts now burn 4% of your mana up to a maximum of 350 mana, down from 8% of your total mana.

[Pending Restart] - [Auchenai Crypts] - Stolen Soul debuff now only reduces damage and healing done by 25% (from 50%) and will be removed when your stolen soul is slain or if 60 seconds pass, whichever comes first. This debuff previously reduced damage by 50% and lasted for 2 minutes and was not removable.
[Pending Restart] - [The Underbog] - The Duration of Corpserunner has been increased by 12.5 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - [The Underbog] - Allergic Reaction (Sneezing Debuff) now triggers less often and has a 30 second duration reduced from 60 second duration and no longer triggers once its applied.

[Pending Restart] - [The Underbog] - The Combined health of Claw and Swamplord Musel''ek will now be equal to the health of all the bosses in the instance instead of the combined health being approximately 135%.

[Pending Restart] - [The Underbog] - Claw will no longer chain charge the same target every 3 seconds. Instead he will now charge the furthest target away every 5 seconds and up to 3 different targets over 15 seconds, then this charge sequence will go on cooldown for 30 seconds. Previously this charge had no cooldown and often targetted the same person. Since the charge is intertwined with dropping threat, Claw will no longer drop threat as frequent (faster than your taunt cooldown).
[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - The Duration of Corpserunner in Botanica has been increased by 15 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - High Botanist Freywinns Blue Saplings Icebolt Stun will now correctly obey diminishing returns and can be interrupted.

[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - Stomp from Warp Splinter now has a 25 Yard Radius (down from 27) and has a 2 second cast time and also now correctly obeys the diminishing returns. This cast time will allow you use proactive cooldowns like Fade or Bladestorm to reduce the effectiveness of the stun.
[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - Saplings that reach Warp Splinter now heal for their remaining HP instead of their full HP. Additionally, these saplings take 40% increased damage.
[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - Allergic Reaction (spreading cloud disease) from Laj will be removed upon killing Laj.

[Pending Restart] - [The Botanica] - Laj is no longer immune to a school of damage when he transforms. Instead he will gain resistant to the element he has become, the damage of taken from that element is reduced by 50% and will increase the damage taken from a different element by 20%. (Listed in tooltip of spell)
[Pending Restart] - [The Arcatraz] - The duration of Corpserunner in Arcatraz has been increased by 10 seconds.
[Pending Restart] - [The Arcatraz] - Heal cast from Daliah the Doomsayer is now interruptable.
[Pending Restart] - [The Arcatraz] - Exhausting Aura from the Ererdar Soul Eaters now only increases the cost of your abilities by 50% from 100%.
[Pending Restart] - [The Arcatraz] - Energy Discharge from the Arcatraz Sentinel now triggers every 1.2 seconds from every 1 second. The damage done remains unchanged.

[Pending Restart] - [The Arcatraz] - Arcatraz Sentinels can no longer spawn unrelenting spirits. This change aims to tone down a very strong combination of the Sentinels Chain Lightning, Grevious Wounds (from taking AoE damage from passing by the chain lightning) and the Unrelenting Spirit keeping you in combat (which allows for Grevious Wounds to continue dealing damage).
[Pending Restart] - Critters in Mythic+ can no longer spawn an unrelenting spirit.

Kaelthas Pyroblast will no longer trigger stagger if under the effect of Devastation (Absorbs the damage from the pyroblast).
Fixed a recent issue where Fierce Blows could bypass blocks. This fixes a significant foundation issue that was meant to be adressed in the last updates to the tanks.

0.description: Pending Restart: Guild Bank Event Log can now contain up to 255 entries.
Fixed Warsong Worldstate UI not displaying flags.
Added and fixed end timers to battlegrounds to smooth out leveling and prevent camping and griefing. End-game battleground timers are longer than Leveling Battleground timers.
Added XP gain to many Battleground objectives like capturing flags, bases, and more.
Prestige Daily Quests are now sequential, this should fix the same one rolling multiple times back to back.

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the spawn location for a crows cache in Zangarmash would be extremely unclear on its location. Its PoI and Location should be shown on the map once it spawns again.

You will still be able to do the attunement normally to gain the Masters Key to your Vanity Collection, but being available on the callboard created misleading expectations.
Many mobs that cast hex now have a cast time, allowing it to be interrupted.
Many leveling mobs that cast slow now have a cast time, allowing it to be interrupted.
Druid of the Fang's Deep Slumber now lasts 6 seconds, down from 15 seconds.
